decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions and due to the scale, proportion, mass and character of the proposed extensions the proposal would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the house and character of the street scene, and is considered consistent with adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 2 Dale Avenue.
description: Erection of single storey infill extension and front porch to semi- detached single dwelling two storey house.
